people.name: people
people.description: Each person's date of birth, work, health and smoking status.

household.name: household
household.description: Marital status and regime, and whether the spouse is part of the plan.

dependants.name: dependants
dependants.description: Children, parents and others who depend on the household, and how long.

education.name: education
education.description: Schooling and tertiary plans for each dependant, and money already saved for them.

income.name: income
income.description: Each person's salary, bonus, other income and payroll deductions.

income_changes.name: income_changes
income_changes.description: Expected changes to a person's income (promotion, retrenchment, going part-time). Forecast only.

expenses.name: expenses
expenses.description: Monthly living expenses, classified into the FNA expense catalog, plus anything that fits no catalog line.

retirement_funds.name: retirement_funds
retirement_funds.description: Pension, provident, preservation funds, retirement annuities and annuities in payment.

assets.name: assets
assets.description: Property, vehicles, cash, investments, business interests and what each is earmarked for.

liabilities.name: liabilities
liabilities.description: Home loans, vehicle finance, cards, loans and other debt.

policies.name: policies
policies.description: Life, disability, income protection, severe illness, funeral and family income cover.

policy_terms.name: policy_terms
policy_terms.description: Waiting periods, benefit terms, definitions and escalations of existing policies.

retirement.name: retirement
retirement.description: When each person wants to retire, the income they want then, and other retirement income.

goals.name: goals
goals.description: Other savings goals (travel, a car, a deposit, a wedding) with cost, timing and savings.

estate.name: estate
estate.description: Wills, executors, guardians, trusts and funeral cost.

estate_needs.name: estate_needs
estate_needs.description: Extra capital or income the family would need on death, bequests, accrual and ported abatement.

risk_profile.name: risk_profile
risk_profile.description: The eight investor risk questions (tolerance and capacity).

engagement.name: engagement
engagement.description: Why the client came for advice, their objectives and concerns, in their own words.

events.name: events
events.description: Uncertain future events with a cash impact (offshore study, inheritance, property sale, emigration). Forecast only.
